name: Agricultural meteorological station
definition: A station affiliated with the application area "Agricultural meteorology".

name: Aircraft meteorological station
definition: A station affiliated with the ABOS program.

name: Automatic weather station (AWS)
definition: A station measuring one of the following observation automatically: pressure, humidity, precipitation, temperature and horizontal wind speed and direction.

name: Climatological station
definition: A station affiliated with the application area "Climate monitoring (GCOS)", "Climate science", "Climate applications" or the programs "GCOS" or "RBCN".

name: Cryosphere station
definition: A station measuring a cryosphere variable.

name: GBON Surface station
definition: A station measuring the variable "Atmospheric pressure" in the context of GBON.

name: GBON Upper air station
definition: A station measuring "Temperature profile" with a radiosonde in the context of GBON.

name: Hydrological station
definition: A station measuring one of the hydrological variables or affiliated to WHYCOS or of station type Lake/River

name: Precipitation station
definition: A station measuring amount or intensity of precipitation.

name: Radar wind profiler station
definition: A station affiliated with the GOS program "Wind Profilers".

name: Radiation station
definition: A station measuring a variable related to downwelling or upwelling radiation.

name: Sea profiling station
definition: A station on sea (fixed, mobile or mobile underwater) measuring the vertical profile of ocean temperature.

name: Space Weather station
definition: A station affiliated with the application area "Space Weather".

name: Surface land meteorological station (SYNOP)
definition: A station on land measuring humidity, pressure, temperature and horizontal wind speed and direction.

name: Surface marine meteorological station
definition: A station on sea (fixed, mobile or on ice) measuring atmospheric pressure.

name: Upper-air / PILOT station
definition: A station measuring upper wind with a radiosonde without additional observations.

name: Upper-air / Radiosonde station
definition: A station measuring vertical profiles of pressure and humidity, temperature or upper wind with a radiosonde.

name: Weather radar
definition: A station affiliated with the WRO program.
